title: Towards Context-Aware Clinical Motion Understanding in Daily Living at Home: Freezing of Gait Detection with Egocentric Vision
abstract: arXiv:2608.13283v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding motion in daily living requires context beyond kinematics, because similar inertial patterns during activities of daily living (ADLs) can reflect intentional stopping, object interaction, or pathological movement impairment. Egocentric vision provides task-related context that may help disambiguate these cases. We investigate this challenge through freezing of gait (FOG) detection in Parkinson's disease (PD), a symptom strongly influenced by contextual factors during ADLs. Using synchronized egocentric video, wearable IMUs, and expert-annotated FOG labels collected from 13 PD participants in their homes, we evaluate frozen representations from pretrained ego-video and time-series foundation models, alongside an IMU-based TCN trained from scratch, under leave-one-subject-out evaluation. The IMU-based TCN achieved the strongest event-detection performance, reaching 42.3 F1 and 83.0 AUROC, compared with 32.6 F1 and 77.2 AUROC

translated_title: 面向居家日常生活的上下文感知临床运动理解：基于自我中心视觉的冻结步态检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13283v1 公告类型：新 摘要：理解日常生活中的运动需要超越运动学的上下文信息，因为日常生活中相似惯性模式可能反映有意停止、物体交互或病理性运动障碍。自我中心视觉提供了与任务相关的上下文信息，有助于区分这些情况。我们通过帕金森病（PD）中的冻结步态（FOG）检测来研究这一挑战，该症状受日常活动中上下文因素的强烈影响。利用从13名PD参与者在家庭环境中收集的同步自我中心视频、可穿戴IMU和专家标注的FOG标签，我们在留一受试者评估下，评估了预训练自我中心视频和时间序列基础模型的冻结表示，以及从头训练的基于IMU的TCN。基于IMU的TCN在事件检测性能上最强，达到42.3 F1和83.0 AUROC，而相比之下为32.6 F1和77.2 AUROC。
tldr: 该论文通过自我中心视觉提供上下文信息，结合IMU数据，在帕金森病患者的居家环境中检测冻结步态，发现基于IMU的TCN模型在事件检测中表现最优，强调了上下文感知在临床运动理解中的重要性。
en_tdlr: This paper leverages egocentric vision for context-aware freezing of gait detection in Parkinson's disease at home, showing that an IMU-based TCN outperforms foundation models, highlighting the role of context in clinical motion understanding.
